verdict.rationale: Anytype's docs describe Queries as live, auto-updating questions over your knowledge base: you define criteria and the Query assembles results as a View. Objects carry typed Properties and custom Types, and the official repo lists database and kanban blocks. Community users independently confirm Notion-style databases, so the core story is delivered. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that query criteria filter on structured property values, and an explicit list of view layouts covering table and list alongside board/kanban.
